patch.value: GH-826: extension commands need structured failure results and preserved remediation
Extension handlers cannot return a machine-readable report with a non-zero process status, while thrown handler remediation and codes are replaced by generic host guidance.

CommandHandlerResult carries a validated non-zero exit channel; structured payloads still render on failure; extension error code and remediation survive host rendering; CLI and SDK integration tests cover both returned and thrown failures
Give extension gates the same structured verdict and recovery contract as core commands
Custom lint, policy, changelog, and preflight commands can serve both CI and agents
Removes the forced choice between structured output and a truthful process exit code
